implementation: Use React.lazy + Suspense or Next.js dynamic() per route
avoid: Importing all pages at root level — large initial bundle
impact: High — reduces initial JS parse and execute time

rule: Avoid barrel re-exports on large modules
implementation: Import directly from source file not from index barrel
avoid: import { x } from './ui/index' where ui has 100 exports
impact: High — tree-shaking breaks with barrel re-exports

implementation: Wrap with React.memo for stable-prop list items and pure displays
avoid: Memoizing every component blindly — overhead without benefit

implementation: useCallback for handlers passed to list renderItem
avoid: Inline arrow function in FlatList renderItem — new ref every render

implementation: useMemo for objects and arrays passed as props
avoid: Inline object prop — new reference every render breaks memo

implementation: Keep state in the lowest component that needs it
avoid: Lifting all state to root provider — unnecessary re-renders

rule: Split large context into focused slices
implementation: Separate context per data domain (auth user settings theme)
avoid: Single large context — every consumer re-renders on any change

implementation: Use React Query SWR or Apollo client-side cache
avoid: Fetching same data in multiple components independently

implementation: Server-side pagination + FlashList or react-window client-side
avoid: Loading all records at once — memory and render time

implementation: Built-in optimization lazy loading and format selection
avoid: Plain img or Image with no optimization

implementation: Add priority prop or rel=preload for above-fold hero image
avoid: Hero image loaded with normal priority — delayed LCP

implementation: Only load weights and characters actually used; preload one variant
avoid: Loading all font weights eagerly — extra network requests
